upload_dir.description: Directory where pending uploads are staged before being sent.

completed_dir.description: Directory where successfully uploaded files are moved (for cleanup or archival).

max_upload_size.description: Maximum total storage (in bytes) allowed for pending uploads. Set to 0 for unlimited.

max_concurrent_uploads.description: Maximum number of uploads that can run simultaneously.

retry_delay.description: Number of seconds to wait before retrying a failed upload.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for a single upload before giving up.

background_upload.description: Whether uploads should continue in the background when no app is active.

allow_metered.description: Whether uploads should proceed over metered (e.g., mobile) connections.

providers.description: List of supported cloud storage providers and their configuration.

enabled.description: Whether this provider is active and available.

account_path.description: Path to the provider-specific account configuration file (if any).

server_url.description: Base WebDAV or API endpoint URL for the cloud service.

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown to users (e.g., in settings).

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logs (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL).

log_file.description: Path to the log file, or '-' to log to stdout.
